title: Vision Transformers Learn Word Meaning from Images Alone
abstract: arXiv:2610.13252v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Can a vision model learn what words mean from pixels alone? We show that the two largest DINOv3 vision transformers organize words rendered in images by word meaning, despite being pretrained using self-supervision on images only, without paired captions, class labels, or other language supervision. We derive word representations from embedding differences between word images and matched controls, then test whether semantically related words are neighbors within each model's embedding space, while controlling for spelling similarity. We find that brand names in the same industry group together, as do nouns from the same semantic domain. Country-capital pairs exhibit consistent vector offsets, similarly to word embeddings trained on text. These word representations also align with the representations of the visual object categories they name. translated_title: 视觉Transformer仅凭图像就能学习词语含义
translated_abstract: 视觉模型能否仅凭像素学会词语的含义？我们展示了两个规模最大的DINOv3视觉Transformer能够按照词义来组织渲染在图像中的文字，尽管它们仅在图像上通过自监督方式进行预训练，没有配对的文本描述、类别标签或其他任何语言监督。我们通过词图像与匹配对照图像之间的嵌入差异来推导词语表示，然后在控制拼写相似性的前提下，检验语义相关的词语是否在每个模型的嵌入空间中互为近邻。我们发现同一行业的品牌名称会聚集在一起，来自同一语义领域的名词也是如此。国家-首都词对之间表现出一致的向量偏移，这与在文本上训练的词嵌入类似。这些词语表示还与其所命名的视觉对象类别的表示相对齐。据我们所知，DINOv3-H和DINOv3-7B是首个展现出这种能力的自监督视觉模型。
tldr: 仅通过图像自监督预训练的DINOv3视觉Transformer无需任何语言监督，就能从图像中渲染的文字学会按词义组织词语，证明视觉模型可以从纯像素中习得词语语义。
en_tdlr: DINOv3 vision transformers pretrained solely with self-supervision on images learn to organize rendered words by meaning without any language supervision, demonstrating that word semantics can emerge from pixels alone.
